prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Louis MO for a home purchase loan?
competitors_mentioned: Mortgage Solutions through Vantage Credit Union
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one best lender for every buyer—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and whether you qualify for assistance. **For a St. Louis buyer, I’d start by getting a quote from Midwest BankCentre**, a local lender that reports substantial home-purchase activity and local decision-making. If you’re a first-time buyer, also compare **Mortgage Solutions through Vantage Credit Union**, which advertises first-time-buyer and down-payment-assistance options for eligible borrowers.

Get written Loan Estimates from at least three lenders, including a broker or another bank/credit union. Compare the **APR, lender fees, points, rate-lock period, and closing timeline**—not just the advertised rate. Ask each whether it can use MHDC assistance if you may qualify; program eligibility and terms vary.

Sources: [Midwest BankCentre](https://www.midwestbankcentre.com/mortgage/), [Mortgage Solutions/Vantage](https://www.vcu.com/borrow/mortgages), [Missouri rate and program overview](https://www.bankrate.com/mortgages/mortgage-rates/missouri/).
